Name: Birthstone Plants
Author: Allayna
Description:
Twelve plants that each grow a birthstone! Not the prettiest art ever, but I wanted to try my hand at a bit of pixel art and custom crop making!
The specific gems can be planted in their months season, ie March/Aquamarine is spring, September/Sapphire is fall, and so on.

Requires SMAPI and Json Assets.
